name: dsh-thinking-levels
description: Auto-detects every custom model configured on the llm-pi-ai row and gives each one its own thinking-level (reasoning effort) configuration in a dedicated Settings sidebar page.

description.en: Detects every configured custom model and lets each one pick its own thinking levels, written back to reasoningEfforts.
description.zh: 自動識別所有已配置的自訂模型，為每個模型單獨設置思考等級，寫回 reasoningEfforts。
